purpose: Matched max(NMS,Kitty Knight) baselines, by explicit user reporting request
development: Two unchanged NMS32 and two unchanged KK32 runs per archived RANDOM case; report each and use stronger valid score of each team. Do not replace missing or failed teams by zero.
fresh: Two KK32 repetitions on each previously frozen RANDOM01/02 V1 and RANDOM03 V2 stream. No PILOT retuning and no fresh inputs generated. Original NMS repetitions and frozen PILOT results are retained.
validity: Full horizons and independent movement, collision, scheduling and task-event replay. Preserve timeout/overrun and failed attempts; report measured timing.
publication: Published max(NMS,KK) remains separately identified as a historical comparison.
